executive_summary: 16 findings across 11 hosts (11 critical, 1 high, 4 medium by CVSS band); 6 are listed in the CISA KEV catalog. Findings are ranked by fuzzy priority using each asset's simulated exposure and criticality. Top 3 by priority: CVE-2021-41773 on Public website (Apache httpd) (172.30.0.12:80, priority 88.3 urgent); CVE-2021-42013 on Public website (Apache httpd) (172.30.0.12:80, priority 88.3 urgent); CVE-2025-24813 on Partner portal (Tomcat) (172.30.0.13:8080, priority 88.3 urgent). Scenario: Simulated ACME Retail environment: public website, online shop, customer portal and public API are internet-facing; the corporate CMS, a partner portal and a staging app sit in the DMZ; CI, logging, search and file sharing are internal only. In reality all containers are isolated on a local Docker network without internet access.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal and RCE
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent

findings.attack_technique: T1083 (File and Directory Discovery) / T1574 (Path Interception / Execution)
findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later, or properly configure Require all denied on directory blocks and ensure Alias directives are tightly scoped. Sources: MITRE CWE: CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html); OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG) / CWE Catalog: Inputs should be decoded and canonicalized to the application's internal representation before validation. Use vetted libraries or frameworks that do not allow path traversal constructs.

findings.label: urgent

findings.attack_technique: T1083 (File and Directory Discovery) / T1574 (Path Interception / Execution)
findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later to address incomplete fixes for path normalization and URL-encoding bypasses. Ensure mod_alias and directory access controls are strictly enforced. Sources: MITRE CWE: CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html); OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG) / CWE Catalog: Ensure that application input validation canonicalizes paths correctly and avoids double-decoding flaws.

findings.remediation: Upgrade Elasticsearch to version 1.4.3 (or later) where the Groovy sandbox vulnerability is resolved. findings.title: CVE-2023-25690 (Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy Request Smuggling)
findings.evidence: lab-host-10:80/tcp running Apache httpd 2.4.25. Certain mod_proxy configurations allow HTTP Request Smuggling due to discrepancies in parsing Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers.
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent

findings.attack_technique: T1027 (Obfuscated Files or Information / HTTP/Request Smuggling context)
findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.56 or later. Carefully review and restrict mod_proxy configurations to prevent inconsistent interpretation of malformed HTTP requests between intermediaries and backends. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-444 Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests, https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/444.html).

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server HTTP Request Smuggling
findings.evidence: lab-host-14:80/tcp running Apache httpd 2.4.25 with vulnerable mod_proxy configurations.
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent

findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.56 or later, and review/harden mod_proxy configurations to prevent request desynchronization and header discrepancies. Source: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG-INJT-15 HTTP Request Smuggling) ,  Enforce strict RFC-compliant parsing, normalize request handling across all proxies/intermediaries, and terminate or revalidate backend connections upon parsing errors.
